operator_level_dedup: Roma AXA/Casal Palocco is counted once under local franchisee DETAMAR S.R.L. Other Mercatino franchise locations must be adjudicated by their own legal operators and are not merged or counted as branches of DETAMAR without legal evidence.
reason: Independent PASS2 confirms a current Rome professional used-goods and used-apparel operator. The current first-party Roma AXA Mercatino site identifies DETAMAR S.R.L. at Via Carneade 11 with current contact and seven-day opening hours. Its current catalogue exposes 'usato firmato' apparel, including men's used/vintage garments with prices. A current commercial-registry-derived source corroborates DETAMAR S.R.L., VAT IT10452721003 and REA RM-1233202. The public site materializes a current item catalogue but does not establish direct remote checkout or ordinary delivery of used apparel to Spain; therefore it is VERIFIED_HOLD rather than ELIGIBLE.
